objectives: 本課程目標為學習線性代數的基本數學概念與運算技巧。
content: 課程內容包括矩陣運算、線性方程式、向量空間、正交、矩陣行列式、線性轉換、特徵值分析與對角化等。
books:
教課書
Gilbert Strang, Linear Algebra and Its Applications, 4th Edition, Cengage Learning, 2006
參考書
Steven J. Leon, Lisette de Pillis, Linear Algebra with Applications, 10th Edition (Global Edition), Pearson Education, 2021.
Gilbert Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra, 6th Edition, New Moon Education, 2023
Howard Anton, Elementary Linear Algebra, 12nd Edition, Asia Edition, John Wiley, 2019.
Ron Larson, Elementary Linear Algebra, 8th Edition, Metric Version, Cengage Learning, 2017.
Stephen H Friedberg, Arnold J Insel, Lawrence E. Spence, Linear Algebra, 4th Edition, Pearson Education, 2014.
